name: principle_id
description: Unique identifier for the ethical principle.

name: category
description: Category the principle belongs to (e.g., risk_management, data_privacy).

name: severity
description: Severity level of the principle (e.g., low, medium, high, critical).

name: parameters
description: JSON object for any specific parameters related to the principle.

name: check_function_name
description: Name of the function used to check this principle.
